童心"Still, there is one thing I cannot understand..."
Kageaki"...?"
童心"No need to put on a puzzled face. You know very well what I cannot understand."
童心"Whose people are you?"
Kageaki"In my position, I cannot answer that. Though a moment ago, you yourself offered a theory."
童心"The hirelingshirelings of the Oyumi Kubo, you say?"
Kageaki"I am not in a position to answer."
童心"No."
Kageaki"..."
童心"Oyumi has no retainersretainers like you. Nor do I recognize those two suits of sword-armor."
童心"More than that... you do not look like the sort who would bow your headsheads to Rokuhara."
Ichijou"..."
童心"Well?"
Kageaki"I am not in a position to answer..."
童心"So I thought. Then it falls to us to put you in a position to answer."
常闇斎"A prisoner under torturetorture is permitted to disclose any secret whatsoever, Lieutenant General sir."
童心"Oh ho! Is that so?"
Kageaki(Muramasa.)

Ichijou"...Do not look at me with those sewer・・ eyes, you pig of a monk. Saala."
童心"Ha-ha-ha! That is exactly it, exactly it!"
童心"Indignation toward the wicked, righteous hatred: ah, that is good. Beautiful, and so delicious. I had my belly full of it just last evening, and still I never tire!"
Ichijou"...You mean the princess!!"
童心"Kuh-huu. Yes, precisely that anger. Such a waste! Had you attacked me on the stage in that rage, the matter would have been settled faster."
Ichijou"That was a trap too!? Is there anything you are not foully persistent・・・・・ about!?"
童心"Arre, two birds with one stone. Why let the second bird go? I would have done it even if you were not there. Skip such an amusement? Would I?"
Muramasa《Mido. I found it, but...》
Kageaki(Can you fire a thread that far?)
Muramasa《Yes.》
Kageaki(Good. Do it.)
Muramasa《Destroy it?》
Kageaki(No. Turn・・ its magnetism.)
Muramasa《Understood.》
Ichijou"...Monk. You, of all people—"
Kageaki"Ichijou."
Ichijou"Hm?"
Kageaki"Listen carefully. Armor and escape."
Ichijou"Wh... what?"
常闇斎"!!"

en.html:
Several events occurred almost at once, though in stages.

First, every light burst together with a sharp report. Darkness closed in around us again.

That alone meant little to warriors. After an instant of confusion, their sight would return. But then something exploded and the floor heaved under their feet, and the confusion could not end in an instant.

ja.html:
幾つかの事態がほぼ同時に、しかし段階的に起きた。

　まず照明が一斉に、音を立てて破裂した。
　辺りが再び闇に閉ざされる。

　それだけならば、武者にとって何程のこともない。
　一瞬は惑乱しても、すぐに視覚を取り戻す。
　だが続いて何かが爆発し、足元が大きく揺らいだと
あっては――混乱も一瞬では済まない。
